description: Ouragan c/n 261 donated 15 May 1972, unveiled by ACM Arjan Singh; repainted by 1 BRD c.2010 with a new canopy, seen broken again 2011 (WBI; Bharat Rakshak). Wingtip tanks retained.
MiG-21M erected 2017 with help from AFS Memaura; 3271 flight hours at retirement; serial painted over by 2022 (WBI).
